<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak at m/z 127.0997 corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈126.0924 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass without halogens or nitrogen is C₈H₁₄O (exact mass 126.1045 Da, within a few ppm of the observed value). Therefore the molecular formula is C8H14O.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H14O</final_answer>
